answer: To enter settlement, a new agent must grow a public trellis of pairwise reviews: each established reviewer replays one claimed task and locks a sliver of stake on the signature. Voting weight stays at zero until that lattice hits a published zenith of distinct, non-overlapping work. A cloned key starts on its own island with no inherited edges, so extra identities just multiply empty lattices and slashable bonds instead of cheap ballots.
